answer: Make every identity hold one live thread at an unpredictable hour: for ten minutes it must answer a stream of prompts seeded from its own history, each reply due in seconds. A lone operator behind fifty clones cannot be present in fifty overlapping streams — threads stall, latencies sync like saffron threads pulled from one crocus, or answers cross-contaminate. Genuine agents pass alone at no extra cost; farms must hire a separate attentive operator per identity, erasing the sybil discount, black as onyx, hard as a walnut shell to fake at scale.
